note: Spuerkeess's Visa Classic credit card costs 24 euros a year (its fee information for the classic current account, 1 October 2025), and what's spent on it is taken from the linked current account in one go at the start of the following month, so nothing is carried; the optional revolving credit states no rate in what the bank publishes. On 2026-10-30 the range was widened to the main banks: Spuerkeess, BGL BNP Paribas and Raiffeisen, the largest retail banks with published price lists (BIL's site states no price list in what it serves, and ING Luxembourg's answered with an empty page). BGL BNP Paribas's list of main charges (from 1 October 2026): the Visa Classic (2 euros a month), Mastercard Gold (5.50), Mastercard Platinum (17) and Mastercard Élite (28), each a deferred-debit card (its page on credit and debit cards: 'La carte de crédit permet quant à elle un débit différé'), so nothing is carried; a cash advance 2.50 euros plus 2%; spending in another currency carries the network's rate plus a mark-up, for US dollars 1.25% on Visa and 1% on Mastercard, written as the foreign fee (sterling the same, Swiss francs 0.40% and 0.85%, other currencies 1%). Raiffeisen's tariffs and conditions (from 4 June 2026) price the Visa Classic at 22 euros a year, the Visa Gold at 65 and the Visa Platinum at 120, a cash advance at 2.50 euros plus 2%, with a mark-up of 1.25% on US dollars; neither the price list nor a card page found states whether the balance is taken in full or can be carried, or at what rate, so its cards aren't written.

sources.title: Spuerkeess, Debit and credit cards: what exactly is the difference?
sources.said: Amounts spent with a credit card are deducted from the linked current account in one go, generally at the beginning of the following month.

sources.title: BGL BNP Paribas, Quelle différence entre une carte de crédit et de débit ?
sources.said: Avec une carte de débit, le débit de votre compte en banque est immédiat. La carte de crédit permet quant à elle un débit différé. ... Ce tarif est de 2,50 EUR + 2 % du montant prélevé.
